title: Warm sealed optimizer profiling
objective: Implement warm prepared source profiling that authenticates and seals the lazy-module closure before CPU sampling, clears warmup telemetry, and fails on late imports without changing ordinary evaluation.

oracles: Exact profile-off/profile-on output and route conservation
Authenticated source map and dashboard identity equality

handoff.summary: Adds a prepared optimizer-profile lifecycle: root load, optional prepare entry, lazy closure compilation, warmups, route reset, exact Inspector source authentication, closure sealing, and repeated sampled entry calls. The CLI exposes --prepare, --entry, --warmups, and --repetitions. Late lazy imports fail before module resolution or compilation, while profiles without an entry retain the existing cold behavior.
risks: The shared profile sampling schema does not yet carry the prepared protocol. Integration must add and independently validate {scope, preparationMicroseconds, warmupRuns, repetitions, declaredArtifactCount, authenticatedArtifactCount, lateArtifactCount, closureDigest} before promotion receipts can prove warm sealing.

OptimizerProfileLateImportError is raised before late import effects, but evaluated Python can catch it. Integration should add a host-owned late-attempt counter and post-entry assertion if caught attempts must invalidate the whole profile rather than only the import operation.
next_steps: Cherry-pick this commit into integration and extend the shared sampling schema/assembler with the agreed prepared protocol object.
Collect the three production workload profiles using --prepare __profile_prepare__ --entry __profile_run__ with catalog-matched warmups and repetitions.
Run final platform and broad repository gates from integration after shared schema changes.
